Register one logical attachment reference.

Source: R/acquisition_catalog.R
acquisition_catalog_register_document.Rd

Attachments without a native ID default to identity_status = "ambiguous" and are keyed by source and position, so matching URLs cannot collapse unrelated records.

Usage

acquisition_catalog_register_document(
  catalog,
  source_ref_id,
  native_attachment_id = NULL,
  attachment_key = NULL,
  attachment_url = NULL,
  section = NULL,
  ordinal = 1L,
  identity_status = NULL,
  legacy_local_path = NULL,
  metadata = NULL
)

Arguments

catalog

A catalog from acquisition_catalog_open().

source_ref_id

Registered source reference ID.

native_attachment_id

Optional trusted native attachment ID.

attachment_key

Stable key when no native ID is available.

attachment_url

Optional source URL.

section

Optional source section.

ordinal

One-based source ordering.

identity_status

identified or ambiguous.

legacy_local_path

Optional legacy path retained as provenance.

metadata

Optional provenance metadata.

Value

A list with document_ref_id and status.
